gr-xendit-7992374003.d:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

Why this role exists

For a payment-infrastructure company, the product is in large part the API. Developers are both the buyers and the daily users, and the quality of the APIs, SDKs, docs, sandbox, and integration path is the product's real surface. This role owns the developer's journey from first API call to production and scale, the difference between a developer who integrates in an afternoon and one who gives up before their first successful transaction.

What you'll own

• The roadmap for the developer experience: integration flow, SDKs, documentation, sandbox, error handling, and time-to-first-successful-call.
• Developer activation and retention as headline metrics, from sign-up to first production transaction and beyond.
• Discovery grounded in developer behavior: integration analytics, support and community signals, and direct developer research.
• Partnership with Engineering on API design and DX standards, and prioritization of DX debt against new capabilities.
• Clear communication of trade-offs to senior stakeholders, and translation of platform changes into a coherent developer-facing experience.

How you will work

You report to the Product Design & UX Director for Customer Lifecycle and work most closely with Engineering, whose API and platform decisions shape the experience you own. Part of your early work is helping define where developer-experience ownership sits, since this surface has not had a dedicated product owner before. You are the strategic owner of the developer journey from first API call to production. Your time splits between developer discovery and roadmap delivery, with constant engineering partnership. The domain works from validated findings rather than assumptions and values direct, candid critique.

What we're looking for

• PM experience with API, platform, or developer-facing products. You have owned products where developers are the user.
• Genuine technical fluency. You can read API docs and discuss schemas, auth, and webhooks with engineers, here this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
• Demonstrated empathy for developer workflows. You understand how developers actually work and where they get stuck.

A strong plus: a background as a developer, or having built SDK, docs, or DX products; payments or fintech experience.

wo-jpfa-JR5610.d:
PT Ciomas Adisatwa mencari kandidat yang berdedikasi dan berkualifikasi untuk posisi ME ES Farm Pullet Magetan CPD (Maintenance Engineer / Engineering Specialist - Farm Pullet Magetan Commercial Poultry Division).

Berlokasi di fasilitas peternakan kami di Magetan, peran ini bertanggung jawab untuk mengawasi, memelihara, dan mengoptimalkan seluruh sistem mekanikal, elektrikal, dan struktural di peternakan ayam dara (pullet). Kandidat yang terpilih akan memastikan efisiensi operasional yang maksimal, meminimalkan waktu henti (downtime), serta mendukung standar biosekuriti dan kesejahteraan hewan melalui pemeliharaan teknis yang prima.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan:

1. Melakukan pemeliharaan preventif dan korektif secara rutin terhadap seluruh mesin peternakan, instalasi listrik, sistem pengatur iklim (climate control), serta peralatan pemberian pakan dan minum otomatis dan manual.

2. Melakukan identifikasi masalah (troubleshooting) dan perbaikan atas kerusakan mekanikal maupun elektrikal dengan cepat guna meminimalkan gangguan pada operasional peternakan.

3. Memantau dan memelihara sistem daya cadangan (generator) serta sistem penyediaan air untuk memastikan layanan utilitas peternakan tetap berjalan tanpa gangguan.

4. Mengawasi dan mengoordinasikan pekerjaan teknis, serta memastikan seluruh aktivitas teknik mematuhi ketentuan ketat PT Ciomas Adisatwa terkait biosekuriti, keselamatan kerja (K3), dan regulasi lingkungan.

5. Mengelola inventaris suku cadang, peralatan kerja, dan perlengkapan teknis, serta menyusun laporan pemeliharaan secara berkala untuk Manajer Peternakan (Farm Manager) dan divisi teknik regional.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan:

1. Minimal lulusan Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Mekatronika, atau disiplin ilmu teknis terkait.

2. Memiliki pengalaman dalam bidang pemeliharaan teknis (maintenance engineering), diutamakan di lingkungan peternakan unggas modern (sistem kandang tertutup/closed-house), industri manufaktur, atau sektor pertanian.

3. Memiliki pengetahuan yang kuat mengenai PLC, instalasi kelistrikan, sistem otomatisasi, generator, dan sistem perpipaan (plumbing).

4. Bersedia ditempatkan di lokasi peternakan di Magetan dan mematuhi protokol biosekuriti peternakan yang ketat, termasuk bersedia tinggal di lokasi (on-site) jika diperlukan.

5. Memiliki kemampuan analisis dan pemecahan masalah yang baik, serta mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun kolaboratif dalam lingkungan peternakan yang dinamis.
